bugs.title: Timing issue with alarm raising
bugs.description: The alarm raising logic does not account for the timing requirement of 300 ms for the third consecutive sample. The current implementation could raise the alarm too early if samples are taken too quickly.

bugs.title: Missing timing check for alarm clearing
bugs.description: The alarm clearing logic does not enforce the 300 ms timing requirement after a sample at or below 8.0 °C, which could lead to premature clearing of the alarm.

bugs.title: Missing debounce for button press
bugs.description: The button press is not debounced, which may lead to multiple detections of a single press due to mechanical bounce.

bugs.title: Chime not starting within 120 ms
bugs.description: The chime may not start within 120 ms of the press due to the delay in the loop, which can exceed the required timing.

bugs.title: Incorrect averaging scale
bugs.description: The averageMm function scales the total incorrectly; it should scale by 1000 instead of 5000 to match the 1 mV/mm scaling.

bugs.title: Lamp state timing issue
bugs.description: The lamp state is updated immediately after taking a sample, which could lead to rapid toggling if the average level fluctuates around the threshold. This should be managed more smoothly.

bugs.title: Missing debounce for button press
bugs.description: The button press may register multiple times due to contact bounce, as the debounce logic does not account for the full bounce duration of up to 10 ms.

bugs.title: Blocking delay in acknowledge function
bugs.description: The delay in the acknowledge function blocks the loop, preventing the heartbeat from being printed during the buzzer sound duration.

bugs.title: Missing debounce for button press
bugs.description: The button press is not properly debounced, which could lead to multiple horn blasts due to contact bounce. The SETTLE_MS value is not sufficient to handle the maximum bounce time of 10 ms.

bugs.title: Blocking delay in horn blast
bugs.description: The delay in the blast function blocks the loop, preventing the heartbeat from being printed during the horn blast duration, which could lead to missed beats.

bugs.title: Missing debounce handling
bugs.description: The sketch does not properly debounce the start button, allowing for multiple bursts to be triggered if the button is pressed and released quickly due to contact bounce.

bugs.title: Incorrect settle time
bugs.description: The settle time is set to 20 ms, which is insufficient for the specified contact bounce of up to 12 ms, potentially allowing multiple bursts to be triggered.

bugs.title: Incorrect debounce timing
bugs.description: The debounce time is set to 12 ms, which is insufficient to handle contact bounce of up to 8 ms. This could lead to multiple triggers being registered from a single press.

bugs.title: Timing issue with valve opening
bugs.description: The valve opening logic does not account for the time taken to process the loop, which could lead to the valve opening later than 100 ms after the press.

bugs.title: Incorrect averaging calculation
bugs.description: The averageMm function scales the total incorrectly by using 5000 instead of 1000, leading to an incorrect level reading in mm.

bugs.title: Potential integer overflow in averaging
bugs.description: The total variable can exceed the maximum value of an int during accumulation, especially with high readings, which can lead to incorrect average calculations.

bugs.title: Missing debounce for button press
bugs.description: The button press on D2 lacks proper debouncing, which may cause multiple triggers due to mechanical bounce, leading to unintended behavior.

bugs.title: Incorrect handling of mode switch state
bugs.description: The variable 'lastMode' is not declared as volatile, which may lead to inconsistent readings of the mode switch state due to compiler optimizations.

bugs.title: Incorrect timing for mixer runs
bugs.description: The mixer can change state more than twice in a 5000 ms window because the next run is scheduled immediately after the current run ends, allowing for a potential overlap in timing.
